scope: Exact specifications and import boundaries. Only the precision-metric uniform-limit continuity target is newly kernel-verified. These real/Banach/Hilbert obligations have no exported Lean implementation here.

obligations.domain: All X : Type with a supplied PrecisionMetric X; k,n,p : Nat.
obligations.normOrMetric: close(k,x,y), with reflexivity, symmetry, precision-triangle and finer-ball laws. A concrete real norm-to-ball adapter is absent.
obligations.statement: Complete m := ∀ u : Nat → X, (∀ k, ∃ N, ∀ n p, N≤n → N≤p → close k (u n) (u p)) → ∃ x, ∀ k, ∃ N, ∀ n, N≤n → close k (u n) x
obligations.boundary: assumedComplete is an explicit USER_AXIOM, never imported by unconditional modules. The uniform-limit continuity proof does not require completeness.

obligations.domain: All x : X, all k,n : Nat; u : Nat → X → Y; f : X → Y.
obligations.normOrMetric: PrecisionMetric Y.close; one common N works for every x.
obligations.statement: ∀ k, ∃ N, ∀ n, N≤n → ∀ x, close k (u n x) (f x)
obligations.boundary: Pointwise convergence cannot replace this common-N hypothesis. The proof derives uniform continuity using approximant N and two precision triangle steps; it does not infer differentiability.

obligations.domain: E a complete normed real vector space; f_n : ℝ → E all C¹; x₀=0; every compact interval K=[−R,R], R>0.
obligations.normOrMetric: The Banach norm ‖·‖_E; derivatives are real Fréchet derivatives.
obligations.statement: Assume ∃v, lim_n f_n(0)=v and ∀R>0 ∀ε>0 ∃N ∀n≥N ∀x∈[−R,R], ‖f'_n(x)−g(x)‖_E<ε. Required conclusion: ∃f:ℝ→E, f is C¹, f'=g, f(0)=v and f_n→f uniformly on every compact interval.
obligations.boundary: No implemented lemma takes derivatives through an infinite sum. This specification is not a kernel theorem and needs a concrete Banach/mathlib adapter and proof.

obligations.domain: E a Banach space; T:[0,∞)→bounded linear maps E→E; t,s≥0; all x∈E; fixed M≥1 and ω∈ℝ.
obligations.boundary: The constants and time domain must come from a proved or explicitly assumed operator construction. A finite spectrum plot supplies none of these operator laws.

obligations.domain: Complex Hilbert space H; densely defined self-adjoint operator A; Borel sets B⊂ℝ; all x∈H.
obligations.normOrMetric: Hilbert norm, projection-valued measure P with countable additivity in the strong operator topology; μ_x(B)=⟨P(B)x,x⟩.
obligations.statement: P(ℝ)=Id; P(B) orthogonal projections; P(B∩C)=P(B)P(C); domain(A)={x:∫ℝ λ² dμ_x(λ)<∞}; Ax=∫ℝ λ dP(λ)x on that domain.
obligations.boundary: M0 GapAt is a predicate on a supplied real set, not this Hilbert/operator/PVM construction. A quantum Yang–Mills continuum model and positive spectral gap remain RESEARCH OPEN.

obligations.domain: All x,y in E and t∈[0,T]; fixed finite T≥0, M≥1, ω∈ℝ; same Banach space and operator semigroup as above.
obligations.normOrMetric: ‖·‖_E; exact constants M,ω,T belong to the evidence binding.
obligations.boundary: Every derivative/continuum-limit use must list its precise domain, norm and constants. No current code consumes these open obligations or upgrades finite convergence tables to an infinite-limit theorem.

comparisonRegistry.requiredAdapter: Identify the exact prismatic comparison theorem, objects, hypotheses and exported Lean target; prove adapter obligations.
comparisonRegistry.modelStatus: MODEL DEVELOPMENT for implementing a known comparison; RESEARCH OPEN for a new comparison theorem.

comparisonRegistry.requiredAdapter: An exact trace theorem and cohomology/Frobenius object identification, with coefficient field, properness and smoothness hypotheses.
An exact known-case theorem with rank, elliptic-curve field, finiteness and arithmetic hypotheses; universal BSD remains RESEARCH OPEN.
Exact original PDE theorem with domain, forcing, regularity, moment/jet, cutoff and bound hypotheses; finite numerical fixtures do not import it.
